from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as found in the report")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the amount")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text from the report containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    tax_records: list[CompanyTaxRecord]
